capacity.fifo_storage_bits_are_not_corridor_track: depth changes local storage/mux cost; crossing width depends on topology, not storage-bit sum

SS_wire_sensitivity.basis: conditional upper bound; actual net topology must establish stage necessity; registers must fit local reserve or geometry be repriced before build

fully_additive_contingency.basis: conservative all-additive reservation, no clock recovery; wire recalibration and actual local fit pending

existing_model_costs.scope: Existing 00e9 conditional reservations; no new geometry or latency adopted. Local fit and rule-complete escapes remain pending.

pricing_scope.warning: Geometry subset of reserved strip does not prove spare contiguous tracks or endpoint reach; no additional modeled clock gain.
